title: wolfHSM slot model: WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM, slot struct, C_Initialize
description:
Add the slot infrastructure that makes wolfHSM a first-class backend type.

What needs to be done:
- Add WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM to the wp11_proto_t enum in wp11_token_db.h
- Extend wp11_slot_t (in wp11_pkcs11.c) with a 'whClientContext *client' field under #ifdef WOLFP11_CFG_WOLFHSM_BACKEND
- At C_Initialize time, read the wolfHSM server address from an environment variable or compile-time default (WOLFP11_CFG_WOLFHSM_SERVER_ADDR) and, if set, create a slot of proto WP11_PROTO_WOLFHSM with token_present=0 initially (slot present but no client context yet — login establishes the connection)
- C_GetSlotList and C_GetSlotInfo must return the wolfHSM slot; C_GetTokenInfo must report label, manufacturer, model

Design decisions:
- One wolfHSM slot per server address; multiple servers could be supported later via a comma-separated list in the env var
- Token label comes from a separate env var (WOLFP11_CFG_WOLFHSM_LABEL) or defaults to 'wolfHSM Server'
- whClientConfig is stack-allocated in C_Initialize, connection deferred to C_Login
